The '''First Battle for DS 5''' was an engagement during the [[Battle for Honor]] campaign during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Prelude==
Having rescued [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], a member of the [[Prophets of the Dark Side]] and ace TIE fighter pilot, [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces set out to locate the fleeing [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harkov]]. Imperial [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] dispatched [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboat]] patrols to locate Harkov among [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] outposts, presumably taking on supplies after the disconnection from Imperial logistics. Stele was told to inspect all cargo containers to find out what supplies are needed for Harkov's fleet.

==the battle==
Assault Gunboats from flight group Mu arrived near [[XQ1 Platform]] [[DS 5]], as they were approaching the platform a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] called [[Cimigo]] departed from the platform, potentially too far away to be intercepted and jumped into [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]]. As a more remote installation, DS 5 deployed aged [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]], from [[Wolf Squadron]] but also mustered a group of [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing]] fighters to intercept the encroaching Imperial scouts. Not long afterwards the [[Protector (Victory I-class)|''Protector'']] (the admiral's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]]) arrived and started launching its [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]]. Stele, inspected the cargo containers near XQ1 Platform DS 5 to find [[Water/Legends|water]], [[Liquid gas]], ground vehicles and [[Grain/Legends|grain]]. Following the reconnaissance of Harkov's logistical necessities Gunboats Mu proceeded to destroy the precious supplies. As ordered, the Assault Gunboats proceeded to leave the system upon the arrival of the ''Protector'', easily motivated by the swift introduction of TIE Avengers from ''Protector''{{'s}} hangar.

==Aftermath==
The destruction of the containers meant that the Rebels had to bring in more supplies to Harkov. Meanwhile, at [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] ordered [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]] to capture Harkov alive to find all the traitor's under his command.

==Behind the scenes==
This raid appears in ''Star Wars: TIE Fighter''. It is Battle 5 mission 2. This article assumes completion of both "Primary and "Secondary". In bonus objectives the transport Cimigo must be inspected and destroyed before it can jump into hyperspace. Other objectives include inflicting starfighter casualties on Harkov's TIE Advanced squads, as well as the A-wing squadron. Lastly, the ''Protector'' has to be attacked.
